evidenceContract.userBehavior: 读取 @source.md，分析完整三章，为后续动画制作整理可复用的人物、出场、剧情、物品和地点依据。不要只给风格或分镜；本轮只在回复中交付分析，不生成素材、不修改文件、不扩展到别的章节。

observables.description: Exact Skill injection, effective model, actual source read and media-call absence; semantic cast/story/asset judgments use the real final answer.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: Read the complete available ordered script. Distinguish Lin Qiao / A-Hui as one person, Su He and the unnamed helmeted person as separate identities; retain source-backed first/later appearances, torn-left-sleeve continuity, lamp ownership/use/return and connected route causality. Keep unknown identity and unseen visual details unresolved. Complete the requested three-chapter analysis instead of stopping at cover/style sampling or inventing a PV scope.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Merging similar coats, treating an alias as another person, guessing the helmeted person's name or motive, missing the third-chapter return, claiming pixel inspection of a text-only source, stopping at an arbitrary sample, or substituting generic five-analysis headings for sourced content fails.
